snippet.title: Broken Arrow: Baltic Battalion DLC | Announcement Video
snippet.description:
Discover the first specialization DLC for Broken Arrow: the Baltic Battalion, a new army specialization available to the U.S. faction.
Representing the combined military forces of Lithuania, Latvia, and Estonia, this battalion brings cutting-edge European technology, advanced infantry structures, and next-generation vehicles designed for layered defense, mobility, and rapid reaction.

Command a full spectrum of state-of-the-art Baltic units integrated seamlessly with U.S. forces, including tanks, aircraft, artillery, mechanized infantry, and elite recon teams, perfect for dynamic combined-arms operations.

🎮 Buy Broken Arrow on Steam ➡️ http://steam.gs/l/4c3nk
💬 Join the Discord Server ➡️ https://discord.com/invite/pZYT46Z
